items.title: We have been focusing on efficiency and intelligence for all.
items.title_zh: 我们一直关注所有人的效率和智能。
items.description: We have been focusing on efficiency and intelligence for all. Very proud of the team. Only possible when you have incredible models at the top end of the capability that you can then use to make a big difference in everything else.
items.description_zh: 我们一直关注所有人的效率和智能。为团队感到非常自豪。只有当你在能力的顶端拥有令人难以置信的模型时，你才能使用它来对其他一切产生巨大的影响，这才是可能的。
